stubs.service: Mastodon server (REST API v1/v2, instance info, nodeinfo, host-meta)
stubs.how: Local Node server (.ui-capture/server/server.mjs) impersonating a Mastodon 4.4.3 instance called 'Rosebud Social' at http://localhost:4440, same origin as the static Phanpy build it also serves. Data is in memory, generated at startup by seed.mjs from content.mjs/content-extra.mjs; likes, boosts, bookmarks, new posts, list edits etc. persist until restart.

stubs.service: Mastodon OAuth sign-in (apps registration, /oauth/authorize, /oauth/token with PKCE)
stubs.how: The stub registers the app and auto-approves /oauth/authorize, redirecting back with a code, as if the browser were already signed in on the instance as @priya. The token endpoint returns a fixed local access token. Phanpy runs its normal login flow and stores the account in localStorage.
Build uses PHANPY_TRANSLANG_INSTANCES=localhost:4440; the stub's /api/v1/translate returns stored English translations for the seeded Spanish/French posts and echoes other text.

stubs.service: Media CDN (avatars, headers, image attachments, link-card images, instance thumbnail)
stubs.how: Procedurally generated SVG artwork served by the stub at /_stub/... (art.mjs): initials avatars, landscape headers, scene-like images per post.
Not advertised by the stub instance (no streaming URL); push subscription endpoint returns 404 so the app shows push as not set up.

notes: Phanpy is a pure static Mastodon client, so it is built with `vite build` (Node 22.19.0 via mise; npm ci) and the build is copied to .ui-capture/out. start.sh runs .ui-capture/server/server.mjs, which serves the build plus a fake Mastodon instance on the same port. The only source change: src/utils/instance-origin.js, which makes Phanpy use http:// (not https://) for localhost instances, used where the app builds instance URLs (api.js, auth.js, oauth-pkce.js, login.jsx, status.jsx, translation-block.jsx). Opening the entry URL runs Phanpy's real login flow (auto-submit to instance localhost:4440, auto-approved OAuth) and lands on the Home timeline signed in as Priya Raman (@priya), a Portland product designer. After that, plain / works because the account is in localStorage. Data: 40 accounts (local plus remote on hachyderm.io, mastodon.social, fosstodon.org etc.), ~160 statuses spread from a few minutes ago to ~4 months ago, including threads, boosts, polls (open and ended), content warnings, image posts with alt text, link cards, edited posts, Spanish/French posts, keyword-filtered posts (warn/hide filters), DMs; ~220 notifications (mentions, favourites, boosts, follows, follow requests, poll results, subscribed posts); 4 lists, 6 followed hashtags, bookmarks, favourites, 2 scheduled posts, 3 filters, an instance announcement, trends (tags/posts/links), search. Main areas: Home, Notifications, Mentions, Lists, Followed hashtags, Bookmarks, Likes, Explore/Trending, Search, Profile (#/localhost:4440/a/<id>), Post threads, Scheduled posts, Filters, Settings, Compose.
